architecture_contract.default_hidden_dimension: min(128, floor(sqrt(number_of_regions))) when ATAC regions are present; otherwise min(128, floor(sqrt(number_of_genes)))
architecture_contract.warning: Implicit hidden and latent dimensions depend on the fold-specific feature inventory. The campaign must freeze explicit dimensions after training-only genes and peaks are fixed.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No universal upstream MultiVI checkpoint is admitted. Train one model inside each outer donor fold and hash every local artifact.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed: A trained model may encode held RNA-only rows and call get_normalized_accessibility without optimization when the frozen gene/peak registries and known covariate categories match.
inductive_inference_contract.forbidden: load_query_data, scArches updating, calibration, or any other parameter/prototype fitting on held or sealed rows unless a distinct outcome-blind lane was prospectively registered.
inductive_inference_contract.modality_weight_rule: Use equal in the common lane. The cell option rejects held-out data in the official API and is ineligible; universal may be evaluated only as a separately frozen native lane.
inductive_inference_contract.unseen_batch_rule: Do not encode donor identity as a batch category. A held donor is not an allowed unseen categorical batch level.

input_contract.api: MULTIVI.setup_mudata in scvi-tools 1.5.0.post1; setup_anndata is deprecated and unsupported for this campaign
input_contract.atac_input: nonnegative snATAC/scATAC peak counts or binary accessibility in MuData with a frozen ordered region inventory
input_contract.feature_alignment: Identical ordered gene and region inventories at training and inference; genes map to GENCODE v49 IDs and regions to GRCh38.p14 0-based half-open coordinates
input_contract.peak_definition: training-partition-only consensus peaks; held donors cannot affect peak calling, filtering, frequency estimates, or order
input_contract.rna_input: raw nonnegative UMI counts in MuData
input_contract.warning: The upstream module infers assay presence from whether each modality block has a nonzero row sum. It does not accept the project's explicit missing-state mask, so unmodified upstream MultiVI fails the missingness admission contract.

missingness_contract.upstream_behavior: mask_expr, mask_acc, and mask_pro are computed from modality row sums greater than zero, conflating structural absence with an all-zero biological observation.
missingness_contract.required_fixture: Prove that held RNA-only rows use an explicit structurally_missing ATAC mask, never observed ATAC, and cannot be confused with observed all-zero rows.

output_contract.common_embedding: posterior mean from RNA-only held rows with identical common-lane head
output_contract.rna_to_atac: get_normalized_accessibility probabilities over the training-frozen peak inventory without observed held-row ATAC
output_contract.uncertainty: Five fixed seeds are separate stability estimates, not biological replicates; any posterior sampling option must be frozen separately.

source_evidence: The exact scvi-tools 1.5.0.post1 tag, source, documentation, license, and PyPI metadata were inspected on 2026-08-22. The package was not installed and no weights were downloaded, loaded, or trained.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Eligible in principle as a locally trained RNA-only inductive embedding plus common head, but no sealed champion admission until explicit missing masks and all data/runtime fixtures pass.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Direct profile candidate after the explicit-mask fixture proves no held-row ATAC use and the peak inventory is training-only.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible standalone because MultiVI has no DNA sequence or allele-effect mechanism.
